powers.name: Artificer's Touch
powers.summary: Cast mending at will using cleric level as caster level. As a melee touch attack, deal 1d6 damage plus 1 per two cleric levels to objects and constructs, bypassing hardness or damage reduction equal to cleric level. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Dancing Weapons
powers.summary: Give a touched weapon the dancing special ability for 4 rounds. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

powers.name: Dazing Touch
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, daze a living creature with no more Hit Dice than cleric level for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Charming Smile
powers.summary: Cast charm person as a swift action with a save DC of 10 + half cleric level + Wisdom modifier. Only one creature can be charmed this way at a time. Usable for rounds per day equal to cleric level.

powers.name: Calming Touch
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a creature to heal 1d6 nonlethal damage plus 1 per cleric level and remove fatigued, shaken, and sickened. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Unity
powers.summary: As an immediate action when an effect targets you and allies within 30 feet, allow each affected ally to use your saving throw result instead of their own. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.
